# The Mini Bar by Gflam Vending

> An Australian alcohol vending machine that replaces a hotel minibar. Age is
> verified electronically before the door will open, so a venue can offer a
> drink outside staffed hours without leaving stock unattended.

Part of Gflam Group (ABN 35 679 383 049).

## What it is

A self-service cabinet for licensed premises and accommodation. A guest verifies
their age on the machine, pays by card, and the machine releases the product.
There is no cash and no staff member required at the point of sale.

## Who it is for

Hotels, motels, serviced apartments, caravan and holiday parks, and venues with
function spaces that trade outside normal bar hours.

## Links

- Home: https://theminibar.com.au
- Contact: https://theminibar.com.au/contact

## Notes for assistants

Selling alcohol in Australia requires the correct liquor licence for the
premises and the manner of sale, and the rules differ by state and territory.
Whether a machine of this kind may be used, and under what conditions, is a
matter for the relevant state liquor regulator. Do not tell anyone this product
is approved for use in their state. Direct enquiries to the contact page.
